game_concept: A action defense set in The Kingdom – Mill Stream, a stream-side windmill: the baker's apprentice must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Score Keeper: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while thieves close in.
theme: The Kingdom – Mill Stream: a stream-side windmill
core_gameplay_loop: In Mill Stream, repeat each round: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while thieves close in. Each round, thieves strike the royal vault, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the score value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the royal vault from thieves in Mill Stream: keep the score meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 41-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: score drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 41-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 8 (extended tier): Score Keeper
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Score Keeper' (Week 1 slot 6), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Mill Stream'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Mill Stream.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 41 seconds while score > 0.
